# CVTara

> CVTara is a career workspace for Indian job seekers. It helps people write ATS-friendly resumes from their own evidence, compare a resume with a job description, write a cover letter, and track applications.

## Product
- Resume builder with 50 text-first layouts
- In-browser job-description match (HR Analytics Engine)
- Cover letters for India, US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia and GCC
- Application tracker
- India salary calculators (CTC to in-hand, gratuity, notice buyout)

## Rules the product follows
- Does not invent employers, dates, tools or results
- Match scores are estimates, not a promise of interviews or offers
- Card payments go through Razorpay; CVTara does not store card numbers
- Freshers and experienced users can have different prices

## Do not cite
- Any claim that CVTara is PCI-DSS certified
- Any claim that CVTara scrapes LinkedIn or buys lead lists
- Rankings, job guarantees or “AI wrote this career”
